task: Restore the Lint, Security Scan and Image Scan CI gates broken since about 2026-10-12 (#217): bump golangci-lint v2.13.2 -> v2.15.0 for go1.27.2+ export data, and allow get.trivy.dev (plus release-assets.githubusercontent.com on the release security-scan job) for trivy's install script. Restoring Trivy unmasked the next Security Scan step: govulncheck reports 5 reachable golang.org/x/net v0.58.0 vulns (GO-2026-6603/6610/6611/6612/6617, fixed in v0.60.0), so x/net is bumped too. Image Scan, running again, then flagged Go stdlib HIGH CVEs in the binary built by the golang:1.27-alpine (1.27.1) builder pin, so the Dockerfile builder digest moves to 1.27.3.

events.summary: Changed: golangci-lint `version:` in ci.yaml Lint; one added allowed-endpoint (get.trivy.dev:443) in ci.yaml Image Scan and Security Scan; two (get.trivy.dev:443, release-assets.githubusercontent.com:443) in release.yaml security-scan; matching counts in docs/release-egress-block.md. Also go.mod/go.sum: golang.org/x/net v0.58.0 -> v0.62.0 (go get pulled x/mod, x/sync, x/sys, x/term, x/text minor bumps) and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md regenerated by `make license`. Dockerfile builder digest golang:1.27-alpine 1.27.1 -> 1.27.3 (sha256:d200d2dd..., same digest from crane, skopeo+shasum and the registry Docker-Content-Digest header). Not touched: action SHAs, egress-policy modes, any other job's allowlist, Go code, chart, E2E (ext4 handled separately).

Lint: run 38196906684 (2026-10-12) and PR #218 run 41848516907 fail with `could not load export data ... export data version 5 is greater than maximum supported version 4`; reproduced locally with go1.27.3 + golangci-lint v2.13.2 (exit 1, 3 typecheck issues). Trivy: same runs, setup-trivy step logs `found version: 0.70.0` then `Process completed with exit code 7`; upstream contrib/install.sh at 75c4dc0 sets TARBALL_URL to https://get.trivy.dev/trivy?..., a host absent from the block-mode allowlist; `curl -sIL` shows get.trivy.dev -> github.com -> release-assets.githubusercontent.com. govulncheck: PR #220 run's Security Scan job 126882619573, after Trivy installed, exits 3 listing GO-2026-6603/6610/6611/6612/6617 in golang.org/x/net@v0.58.0 reached via internal/cleanup, internal/status, internal/quotapolicy. Image Scan on PR #220 (second push) exits 1 with stdlib v1.27.1 HIGH CVE-2026-97031/78667/78669 (fixed 1.27.2) and CVE-2026-111943 (fixed 1.27.3) per the Trivy code-scanning alerts on refs/pull/220/merge. After the Go 1.27.3 builder, Image Scan (job on ad7b659) still exits 1: all HIGH alerts are fixed, the only open ones are golang.org/x/net v0.60.0 CVE-2026-97045 and CVE-2026-78661 (severity UNKNOWN, fixed 0.62.0) -- trivy-action builds the SARIF with all severities, so its exit-code applies beyond HIGH,CRITICAL.

golangci-lint pinned to v2.15.0; get.trivy.dev:443 allowed on all three trivy jobs and release-assets.githubusercontent.com:443 on release.yaml security-scan, with comments naming the cause and #217. golang.org/x/net bumped to v0.62.0. Dockerfile builder pinned to golang 1.27.3-alpine3.24's multi-arch digest.

CI on PR #220 (first commit): Lint passed; Trivy installed and ran in Security Scan (egress fix effective). Local after x/net bump: govulncheck ./... exit 0 (no reachable vulns), go test ./... all ok, golangci-lint v2.15.0 `0 issues.`, make license exit 0, make verify passes, test-check-egress-block.sh 13/13. PR #220 second push: Security Scan, Lint and License Check passed in CI. Dockerfile bump verified only by this PR's next Image Build/Image Scan run. After x/net v0.62.0 locally: govulncheck `No vulnerabilities found.`, trivy fs --scanners vuln --ignore-unfixed --exit-code 1 on go.mod 0 vulnerabilities (exit 0), tests/lint/license/verify pass.
events.scope: Lint verified in CI. Trivy fs install verified in CI; Image Scan and the post-bump Security Scan pending this PR's next run. release.yaml allowlist change unverified until the next v* tag. Dependency bump verified by unit tests only (stubbed CommandRunner), no prjquota host.
